## About
Right Price Rooter and Plumbing is a family owned and operated plumbing contractor in Glendale. We take care of households, businesses and industries across Glendale and Los Angeles.
We know plumbing problems can be costly and stressful. So we promise to answer all your questions, explain the job thoroughly, and give you the right price before the work begins.
Our neighbors know us by name. Reviewers mention Mick and his crew, and one homeowner thanked Giovanni, Mario and Anthony for explaining everything along the way. Another wrote that Fabian and the crew put their garden, lawn and drive back the way they found it.

## Services
- Drain & Sewer Cleaning: Rooter service and drain cleaning for kitchens, bathrooms and sewer lines.
- Removal of Tree Roots and Sludge: We clear roots and buildup that block your lines.
- Hydro Jetting: High pressure cleaning for any drain 2" to 6". Ask about our Hydro Jet specials.
- Water Heater Repair/Replacement: Repair or replacement when your hot water quits.
- Tankless Water Heaters: An energy efficient option for your home.
- Trenchless Pipe Bursting Method: Sewer pipe replacement with less digging.
- Parma-Lines Lateral Lining System: Lining for damaged sewer laterals.
- In-Line Sewer Video Camera: We look inside the line so we can show you the problem before we fix it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us and we can give you a free estimate over the phone.

Q: Can I call you at night or on a holiday?
A: Yes. We are open 24 hours every day of the week, including holidays.

Q: Is the work covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. A warranty is applied to all of our jobs.

Q: How do I schedule a service call?
A: Call us, or send a service request with your preferred date and time. We will contact you to confirm or suggest another time.
